oncall-bot: ALERT: high error-rate (5xx) on inference-api-prod · 1912345678
triage-bot: Pager routed to @Maria Gomez (on-call) · please ack and join bridge: https://call.redwood/1912345678
Maria Gomez: Acked. Joining bridge, pulling logs now. Seeing spike starting ~09:12 UTC.
Samir Patel: What region? any customers impacted?
Maria Gomez: us-east-1 primarily, small spike in eu-west-1. Early signs: KV cache evictions + 429->retry storms. Customer-facing 5xx at ~0.8% -> 6% at peak.
Alex Chen: Pulling autoscaler logs — saw a flurry of API retries triggering new worker spinups, but qps stayed high and some pods hit OOMs.
Jordan Lee: Pushed temporary routing change to divert low-priority traffic to fallback model v2-quant while we stabilize.
Sasha Ivanov: Good move. Can we throttle background batch jobs? Those appear correlated.
Maria Gomez: Throttled batch-scheduler -> reduced load.
Samir Patel: Re: paging noise: this alert threshold was at 0.5% 5xx over 5m. We hit 0.8% — but noise in pre-prod had similar bursts. Suggest we review severity routing.
Alex Chen: For immediate containment: 1) keep batch throttle, 2) enable fallback route, 3) increase pod memory on hotspot service (temp). I'm doing (3) now.
triage-bot: Incident triage checklist: containment done? please mark steps.
Maria Gomez: Containment: yes. Customer impact: degraded responses for 2 customers on high-volume endpoints, CS notified.
Samir Patel: Action: schedule postmortem and SLO review. I can own alert-rule changes and a follow-up PR.
Jordan Lee: I'll own infra remediation (autoscaler tuning + memory config), assign to myself.
Sasha Ivanov: I'll run an eval on model fallback correctness to ensure we didn't regress outputs.
Maria Gomez: Postmortem to be scheduled this week. Proposed slots: Thu 15:00 or Fri 11:00 UTC. Preference?
Samir Patel: Thu 15:00 works for me.
Alex Chen: Fri 11:00 better for me.
Maria Gomez: OK — Thu 15:00 majority — booking and creating doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1912345678
Samir Patel: Immediate monitoring follow-ups (action items):
- lower-priority: create metric for "retry-after-429" spikes (owner: Samir)
- medium: add KV eviction rate alert tied to tail latency (owner: Alex)
- high: add cooldown window in pager policy to avoid alerting on short-lived spikes (owner: Samir)
Jordan Lee: Infra action items:
- adjust autoscaler cooldown to 60s -> reduce oscillation (owner: Jordan)
- add node memory buffer to hotspot pool (owner: Jordan)
Sasha Ivanov: QA action items:
- run canary prompts on fallback model to confirm no semantic regressions (owner: Sasha)
Maria Gomez: Also: update runbook section "inference-api high 5xx" with steps we did and the temporary mitigations we used. I'll draft.
Samir Patel: For paging rules: propose adding a small burn-rate detector vs raw threshold. e.g., if SLO burn-rate > 3x for 2m, page; otherwise if single 5m window, send infra slack only.
Alex Chen: Agree. Also add a quiet-hours escalation policy: during low-traffic windows we can raise threshold proportionally to baseline noise to reduce false pages.
Maria Gomez: Good idea. Make sure any quiet-hours changes still surface customer-impacting events.
triage-bot: Logged action items to tracker: https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-5432
Maria Gomez: Closing bridge. Thanks all. We'll update postmortem doc with timeline and owners. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll open the alert-rule PR after doc is up.
Jordan Lee: I'll follow up with a deployment for autoscaler tuning tomorrow morning.
Sasha Ivanov: I'll post canary results in the postmortem doc.
Maria Gomez: Last note — small ops improvement: add a short-lived suppress window for non-prod induced spikes (owner: Sam).
triage-bot: Incident resolved · 1912345723
